company.name: Conduct
company.shortDescription: Conduct is an AI operating system designed for enterprise software, assisting IT teams in modernizing and managing their systems.
company.description: Conduct develops an AI-powered platform that helps organizations understand, manage, and modernize complex enterprise software systems, with an initial focus on SAP environments. Its technology analyzes custom code, configurations, and system dependencies to provide visibility into how business processes are implemented and interconnected. The platform combines technical information with business context and existing documentation, allowing users to ask questions and receive answers based on their own systems. Conduct also supports tasks such as identifying redundant customizations, assessing the impact of system changes, and maintaining up-to-date documentation. The company is used by enterprises undergoing system transformation and migration projects to improve understanding of their existing software landscapes.
